transcript: If you're obsessed with brown butter like I am, this is going to be your new favorite cookie recipe. Now in the words of Ina Garten, you're going to want to use really good quality butter for these cookies. It provides so much more flavor that you can actually see compared to basic store-brand butter. And if you're making brown butter cookies, you might as well go ahead and use the good stuff. Plus we're adding one extra egg yolk, lemon juice, and some corn starch for a delicious rich texture. Now these use dark and milk chocolate. The grocery store was out of regular milk chocolate, but they had this hazelnut, so I thought why not. And it was destiny because it works so well in these cookies. Now because these are a very butter forward cookie, the dough does have to chill overnight. But I can't prepare it for once, so I already had a batch ready to go. These bake, add some sea salt, and you're one bite away from heaven.
